title: Geologic Map of the Calfpen Bay Quadrangle, Jasper County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2013, Geologic Map of the Calfpen Bay Quadrangle, Jasper County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-161, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face garbled. Symbols QPldr and QPphr appear near the Ladson and Penholoway flood plain/silt descriptions but cannot be tied to one unit; not recorded. Freshwater marsh symbol printed 'QHtw' (map face 'QHiw') sent to review. Carolina bay thickness '| to 6 feet' read as 1 (inferred, review). Legend-only items (contact symbol, drill-hole symbol) not recorded; drill holes 27-336 and 27-332 appear only as map labels, logs on file at SCGS.
SUBSURFACE: p.1 gives elevation ranges of formation margins (Ladson >35/<57 ft; Penholoway >57/<70 ft; Wicomico >70/<90 ft; Ten Mile Hill beds seaward, Marietta unit landward), stored as contacts; vertical datum not stated (horizontal 1927 North American Datum; contour interval 5 feet; base map USGS 1988); SCGS drill-hole locations with log IDs on map (logs not included). No cross sections or structure-contour maps.
Re-read of page 1 for subsurface fields (single OCR map sheet; text panels legible, map face garbled). Units as before; map symbols read from the legend boxes on a page-image tile (the freshwater marsh box reads QHfw; OCR printed 'QHtw'). Carolina bay thickness '| to 6 feet' read as 1 (inferred); 'LOYR 8/6' read as 10YR 8/6 (inferred). Formation margin elevations (Ladson 35/57 ft; Penholoway 57/70 ft; Wicomico 70/90 ft, seaward/landward) are recorded as contacts and as stated unit tops at those margins (boundary inferred; no vertical datum printed). Whole-page image checked: no cross section or structure contours; SCGS drill holes (27-3xx, 25-1xx) plotted by label only, without depths (logs on file at SCGS). Legend-only symbols not recorded.
